ines: quick heads-up from exploratory testing on the model catalog compare & filters. ran into a few UX/accessibility friction points when pinning versions while using filter presets. tagging @kim + @sam. :wave:

sam: can you summarize steps to repro?

ines: sure: open catalog -> apply a filter preset (e.g., "low-latency") -> select two models -> press Compare -> pin one row. after pin, keyboard focus and the visible compare viewport shift unexpectedly. also filter chip states lose highlight after pin.

lucy: thanks. i saw something similar — filter chips appear to re-render and drop the `aria-pressed` state momentarily when the compare panel refreshes. might be caused by a whole-list rerender rather than targeted updates.

kim: from design: expected behavior is that pinning is a local change to the compare panel and should not disturb filter controls. we also want the pin affordance to be concise. current label says "Pin version" which some users think pins the whole compare. proposal: change button text to "Pin" and provide a tooltip "Pin — keep this version visible in comparisons".

sam: engineering note: we implemented pin as part of the catalog state tree and it triggers a top-level reconcile which re-renders the filter bar. easy fix: scope updates to compare slice and avoid bubbling state changes. i'll investigate.

ux-bot: accessibility reminder: moving interactive nodes can cause screen reader focus loss. If we must visually relocate, prefer CSS techniques (sticky/transform) or a non-interactive visual clone. Announce state change via a single `role=status` message: "Pinned: v1.4.2".

ines: also the performance badges in the compare table show tooltips that get clipped when the pinned anchor is near the panel edge. i captured a short screencap.

lucy: for tooltips we should mount them in a top-level portal (body) so they escape container overflow. Also ensure the tooltip content includes an accessible text alternative e.g., `aria-label="Latency p95 420ms"`.

kim: design preference: make the pinned row visually anchored but keep the original DOM row in its place. Clone must be inert (`aria-hidden` + `tabindex=-1`) so keyboard focus doesn't duplicate. This lets screen reader focus remain correct while preserving the visual grouping.

sam: implementation options: (A) CSS sticky header for pinned items; (B) render a `position:fixed` visual clone that mirrors the original and listens for pointer events via delegation. (A) is simpler and avoids event delegation.

ines: small copy nit: when a user pins a version, we currently show a toast "Version pinned". let's make it more informative: "Pinned v1.4.2 — will remain visible in compare views" and include an undo link.

lucy: agree. toast should be `aria-live="polite"` and include an accessible undo button. Also on keyboard toggle, update an inline `role=status` that SRs announce e.g., "Pinned v1.4.2".

kim: i'll update the spec: change button to "Pin", tooltip -> "Pin — keep this version visible in comparisons", add microcopy for toast/undo. i'll also add a brief a11y checklist: stable DOM, `aria-hidden` clones only, `aria-live` summary, tooltip portal, percentile numbers on perf badges.

sam: i'll scope the state updates and try sticky approach first. pinging @ines & @lucy for QA when PR is ready. leaving this thread open for followups. :thumbsup:
